message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && grep -rn "memset\|regs_read_count\|groups_count\|regs_write_count\|get_insn_id" arch/WASM/*.c | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
The EVM disassembler does `memset(MI->flat_insn->detail, 0, offsetof(cs_detail, evm)+sizeof(cs_evm))`. This zeroes the detail structure up to and including the `evm` union. So `regs_read_count`, `regs_write_count`, and `groups_count` are all zeroed. So EVM is safe.

Let me look at the WASM architecture, which is newer.
